instruction_summary: 2026 model-refresh tick extending the 001 living-update ladder: add the newest 2026 flagships (primarily Qwen3.5-9B, plus gemma-4-12B) as BEHAVIORAL-only IOI points via raw transformers (AutoModelForImageTextToText), reuse ALL prior per-model results, re-aggregate old+new, and extend the over-time figure to 2026 — reporting whether the paper's IOI finding still holds in the newest models.

steps.description: Reused prior 001 living-update: copied its results/per_model/* (8 Tier-1 + 2 Tier-2 JSONs) and its workspace scripts (tier2_behavioral.py, make_figures.py, build_summary.py, ioi_prompts.json) into this study; treated every 001 model as DONE (no recompute).
Fresh uv venv (.venv-2026) with torch 2.14.0 + transformers 5.17.0 (the 001 Tier-2 venv transformers 4.46.3 does NOT know model_type qwen3_5; 5.17.0 registers qwen3_5 and gemma4_unified).
steps.command: uv venv .venv-2026 --python 3.11 && uv pip install torch transformers accelerate safetensors matplotlib

steps.description: Smoke-test Qwen3.5-9B-Base: load via AutoModelForImageTextToText (arch Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration), one forward -> logits [1,T,248320], one activation read output_hidden_states len=33 (=32 layers+1); text decoder is m.model.language_model (Qwen3_5TextModel, 32 layers) NOT m.language_model as the instruction sketch said.
steps.command: python (inline smoke test) — load + m(**ids, output_hidden_states=True)
outputs: confirmed hookable text decoder m.model.language_model.layers[L]; IO logit > S logit on the example prompt

steps.description: Behavioral IOI (Tier-2 analog of C2) for Qwen3.5-9B-Base via transformers, reusing the same 200 IOI prompts + single-token-name filter + END-scoring as 001.
Behavioral IOI for Qwen3.5-9B (instruct) — secondary 2026 point.
Behavioral IOI for gemma-4-12B (base) — second 2026 model; verified downloaded (23GB) + hookable (arch Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration, 48 layers).
Re-aggregate ALL (8 Tier-1 + 5 Tier-2 = old+new) from disk and extend the over-time figure to the 2026 point; regenerate behavioral-vs-scale and the Tier-1 faithfulness ladder for self-containedness.

key_results.headline: The paper's IOI finding STILL HOLDS in the newest 2026 models — behaviorally even stronger than GPT-2. Qwen3.5-9B-Base logit-diff +5.46 (IO>S 99.0%), Qwen3.5-9B instruct +5.84 (99.5%), gemma-4-12B +5.71 (100%); all >> the GPT-2-small replication anchor +3.49.
key_results.loader_recipe: AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained(PATH, dtype=bfloat16, device_map='auto'); text logits = m(input_ids=ids).logits; text decoder = m.model.language_model (32 layers Qwen3.5 / 48 layers gemma-4).
key_results.circuit_discovery: NOT available for these multimodal architectures (easy_transformer fork + TransformerLens cannot load qwen3_5/gemma4_unified; nnsight cannot wrap them). Tier-2 BEHAVIORAL-only as instructed — no faithfulness / circuit for the 2026 models.

comparison_to_original.note: IOI behaviour holds and STRENGTHENS in the newest 2026 models; ~1.6x the GPT-2-small anchor
near-perfect IO>S preference preserved into 2026, matching the GPT-2 anchor

comparison_to_original.quantity: IOI baseline logit-diff — 2026 vs 2024 modern Tier-2 (both behavioral)
comparison_to_original.note: the newest generation stays at the top of the range set by the 2024 modern models
all 97 names single-token -> all 200 prompts scored (>=15, so attempted, not held out)

deviations: The 2026 flagships are BEHAVIORAL-only (as the instruction mandates): the easy_transformer fork / TransformerLens cannot load qwen3_5 or gemma4_unified, and nnsight cannot wrap them, so no circuit discovery / faithfulness (C3/C4/C9/...) is computed for them. This is the same limitation the 001 Tier-2 models had, extended to 2026.

The instruction's loader sketch used `dec = m.language_model`; in transformers 5.17.0 the text decoder is at `m.model.language_model` (Qwen3_5TextModel, 32 layers) — attribute path adjusted after inspecting the module tree. Forward/logits (`m(input_ids=ids).logits`) work exactly as sketched.

Needed a newer transformers than the reused 001 Tier-2 venv (4.46.3, which lacks qwen3_5): built a fresh .venv-2026 with transformers 5.17.0 / torch 2.14.0. All weights loaded OFFLINE from the local cache; no /home writes.

gemma-4-12B WAS present (23GB, fully downloaded) and hookable, so it is included as a second 2026 point (base, matching the ladder's base-model convention). Both Qwen3.5-9B base and instruct were run.

Over-time x-axis uses APPROXIMATE release years (GPT-2 2019, Pythia 2023, Qwen2.5/SmolLM2 2024, Qwen3.5 2026.2 per instruction, gemma-4 ~2026.6); used only for figure ordering, not for any quantitative claim.
